name: ai-boundary
description: Where AI may and may not act. Enforced by AiBoundaryTest and by the pre-apply gates in Agent 13; this file parameterizes those gates, it does not grant authority.
rule_r9: No AI output is ever an authorization for a change.
rule_r10: The harness runs end-to-end with AI disabled, and does so in CI.
rule_r11: AI output reaches the filesystem only through FileMutationGateway.
permitted_uses: Suggest a repair for a compiler diagnostic cluster
Cluster diagnostics by probable root cause
Draft a rationale for a human to review
forbidden_uses: Decide that a version is compatible
Classify a test failure as expected
Decide a behavioural difference is acceptable

prompt_content.redaction: SensitiveValues.redact applied to every prompt segment
